title: OmoRouter `registerAccount` does not validate `msg.sender` as owner
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  The `registerAccount()` function does not check if `msg.sender` is the owner of the `account` being registered.
